decisions.rationale: Inter webfont bundled into the WEB build and used by the HMI. OFL-1.1 permits bundling, embedding and redistribution with software, including commercial software.
decisions.obligations: Keep the OFL-1.1 text and the font copyright notice in the distributed third-party notices; do not sell the font by itself; a modified font must not use the Reserved Font Name.

decisions.approval: 2026-11-01 explicit user instruction: gap remediation step 1, triage the Supply Chain Gate
decisions.rationale: Prebuilt libvips/sharp binaries pulled in by the sharp devDependency, which processes brand images at build time (scripts/prepare-brand-delivery.mjs). Only the generated images enter artifacts; the binaries are not distributed.
decisions.obligations: If sharp or libvips binaries are ever shipped (e.g. inside an Appliance toolchain), provide LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts, the libvips corresponding source, and allow replacement of the shared library.

decisions.rationale: Browser-support data read by browserslist at build time only (devDependency chain); not copied into WEB artifacts.
decisions.obligations: Attribution (CC-BY-4.0) is required only if the data itself is redistributed, e.g. in a source or toolchain bundle; keep the notice in that bundle.

decisions.approval: 2026-11-01 explicit user instruction: gap remediation step 1, triage the Supply Chain Gate
decisions.rationale: Declared runtime dependency, but the public build has no import of it (only the private STEP import provider uses it; verified by searching src/ and the built dist/). Present in the npm tree, not in public WEB artifacts.
decisions.obligations: Any build that ships the OCCT WASM must provide the LGPL-2.1 text, the corresponding source of occt-import-js 0.0.23 including the scripts/patch-occt-memory.mjs modification, and keep the WASM a separately replaceable file (A-07).

decisions.rationale: SPDX exception identifiers used by the supply-chain scanner and ESLint tooling at development time only; not part of any shipped artifact.
decisions.obligations: Attribution (CC-BY-3.0) applies if the package is redistributed in a source or toolchain bundle.
